scoring_justification: Checker extracts main peak energy from the agent's raw spectrum CSV; a genuine DFT-LDA run is required to produce a physically correct peak location.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental main peak energy for interband optical conductivity of hcp Mg
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Mathewson & Myers, J. Phys. F 3, 623 (1973), cited as Ref. 13 in the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is the experimentally measured peak position; needed to score the computed DFT-LDA spectrum against the real experimental result.

outputs.description: Interband optical conductivity spectrum of hcp Mg computed from DFT-LDA. The hidden checker extracts the energy at maximum sigma and compares it to a confidential experimental gold standard, rewarding proximity below a defined tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checked quantity is the main peak energy (eV) derived from this spectrum. The agent is not required to download experimental data.

steps.description: Extract energy at maximum sigma and compare to hidden experimental peak energy.
